Use our AI-driven keyboard in all your apps.

►MAKE A GREAT RESUME

record.description_evidence:
Write better. Get answers. Type a lot less. Auri is a keyboard with an assistant inside, so you can speak, write, fix, translate, and ask in any app.

Hi, I'm Auri. Tell me what you want to say or do, and I'll help right where you type. Rated 4.7 and used by 250,000+ people.

► IN YOUR KEYBOARD, IN ANY APP

- Say it with voice dictation (industry-leading accuracy with a 1.1% word error rate). Tap the mic and talk the way you talk. I drop the filler, keep what you meant, and type it clean. Change your mind mid-sentence; I follow. Pick how it lands: Raw, Clean, Concise, Casual, or Professional.

- Fix it in one tap. Grammar, spelling, and punctuation in any language. Paraphrase in 22 styles, from Concise to Business Email to Persuasive, or describe your own. Translate into 31 languages as you type. Continue a sentence, or give me the topic and I'll write the draft.

- Ask me without leaving the app. Tap my key and ask about your text, your schedule, or anything at all. 

- Let me do it. From the keyboard or the app, I can add a calendar event, set a reminder, look up a contact, find places near you, search and send Gmail, and read or update a Notion page. I show you what I'm about to do and wait for your Confirm. Every source is yours to allow or turn off in Settings.

- Still a full keyboard. Swipe typing, 83 languages, every layout: QWERTY, QWERTZ, QZERTY, AZERTY, Colemak, Dvorak, 30 themes, a keyboard clipboard for the things you type often, and a vocabulary that learns your names.

► OPEN AURI WHEN IT NEEDS MORE ROOM

- Chat with four engines and 20 personas. Auto picks for you. Fast is for everyday questions, Reasoning for the hard ones, and Visual answers as a screen you can explore: cards, comparisons, and steps you can tap.

- Ask to check your email, update your Notion, find places, manage your calendar, or set reminders. 

- Hand me a PDF, a photo, or a scan and ask about it. 

- Ask for a PDF, a CSV, or an image and I'll create the file.

- I remember what matters from one chat to the next, when you let me. Clear it any time.

► RECORD IT. GET THE NOTES.

- Record a meeting, a lecture, or a thought on a walk. Import an audio or video file, paste a YouTube link, or scan a PDF. I transcribe it perfectly in 58 languages with speaker labels, then turn it into meeting notes, a summary, a checklist, a blog post, an essay, or a translation. Everything lands in your Library, next to your notes, where you can ask me about any of it.

- Write notes in Markdown with headings, checklists, tables, and images. Dictate into them. Export as PDF, DOCX, Markdown, and more.

► ON YOUR WATCH AND YOUR MAC

Ask me from your wrist, record voice notes, or dictate on Apple Watch straight into your iPhone keyboard or your Mac with Auri Voice. The Auri app on Mac carries your chats and Library. Words you add once follow you across every device.

► YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS

I'm privacy-first by design. I don't collect what you type or say. I never appear in password or card fields. Notes and chats are encrypted in your own iCloud, requests carry no personal identifiers, and nothing is used to train AI models. Your calendar, mail, location, and Health are read only when you allow it, and only for the request you made.

► FREE TO START. PRO WHEN YOU WANT NO LIMITS.

The free plan gives you the full keyboard with 83 languages, swipe typing, dictation, writing tools (writing, translation, paraphrasing, grammar check), chat (Fast, Reasoning, Visual), and state-of-the-art transcription, counted by minutes and daily uses. Auri Pro stops counting and unlocks unlimited usage, adds every keyboard theme, layout, and every translation language. One subscription for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

Questions? Write to me at hi@auri.ai or open Need Help in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://auri.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://auri.ai/terms

MeraChat -- Your AI, All in One Place

Why juggle multiple AI apps? MeraChat brings together GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, and more into a single, beautifully simple chat interface. Ask questions, generate and edit images, analyze documents, write code, brainstorm, and talk hands-free -- all from one app that speaks your language.

How is MeraChat different?
Most AI apps lock you into one model. MeraChat gives you the world's best AI models -- GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek -- and lets you switch instantly. Plus, MeraChat works natively in 21 languages with full voice support. Not just translation -- truly native AI conversations in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, and more.

Which AI models are available?
Switch seamlessly between OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, and more. Pick the right model for every task. New models are added regularly.

What can MeraChat help me do?
Built-in AI tools for everyday tasks:
- Create Image -- generate stunning visuals from text
- Edit Image -- modify and enhance images with AI
- Coding Help -- write, debug, and explain code
- Brainstorm -- generate ideas and creative solutions
- Help Me Write -- draft emails, essays, and posts
- Summarize -- condense articles, documents, or conversations
- Translate -- translate between supported languages
- Explain -- break down complex topics simply
- Create Prompt -- craft effective prompts for better results
Every tool is built into your chat -- no separate apps needed.

What languages does MeraChat support?
Chat in 21 languages with full UI and voice support:

Indian: English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese.

International: Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Japanese, Russian, German, Korean, Indonesian.

Not just translated -- truly native multilingual AI.

Can I talk to AI using voice?
Yes! Voice input and output in any supported language. Ask questions, get spoken answers, and multitask without typing.

Can I upload documents?
Upload PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and more. Ask questions and get instant answers. Works with scanned documents too.

Does MeraChat search the web?
Get real-time answers with source links. Paste any webpage link to summarize, extract data, or ask questions about its content.

Private mode?
Yes. Private conversations are never saved. No history, no traces.

Offline access?
Read conversations without the internet. Messages queue and sync when you're back online.

Is MeraChat safe?
Biometric lock (Face ID / Fingerprint) and full data control. Export or delete your data anytime -- your data, your rules.

Is it free?
Start free -- no credit card required. Upgrade to Pro for higher limits and advanced features.

More features:
- Rich markdown and code rendering with syntax highlighting
- Share conversations and AI-generated images
- Star and organize important conversations
- Light, Dark, and System themes
- Search across all conversations

Who is MeraChat for?
- Students -- research, study, and get help in your language
- Professionals -- draft emails, analyze documents, brainstorm
- Creators -- generate and edit images, write content, explore ideas
- Everyone -- ask anything in your language and get expert answers

record.name: Skales - AI Agent & Tasks
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Skales is an AI agent that does the work, not just the talking. Give it a job and it plans the steps, uses real tools - calendar, tasks, web, files, contacts - and delivers a finished result, asking your permission at every step. It runs on the AI of your choice, pairs with your computer, and keeps everything it knows about you on your device. No terminal, no setup. Install in seconds.

WHAT AN AGENT DOES THAT A CHATBOT CANNOT
"Plan my Friday" becomes a structured schedule in your real calendar. "Research this and write me a briefing" becomes cited sources and a document. "Open a ticket and tell me what they answer" becomes an API call, made with your approval, with the reply shown to you. Turn on Pocket Run and the agent keeps working across many steps until the job is done - it does not stop at a wall of text.

EVERY MAJOR AI, ONE APP
Start free with Skales IQ - just your email, no API key, no card. Or bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, OpenRouter and more. Chat with Claude, GPT, Gemini and dozens of others, pick the reasoning depth per conversation, attach photos and files, and switch models anytime without losing your session.

AUTOMATION WITH A HARNESS
Skales is built as an agent harness: tools, memory, skills and permissions working together. Built-in agents (planner, coder, studio) plus custom agents you build yourself - or a whole team of agents from a preset. A curated skill library ships with the app, from disciplined bug diagnosis to research with cited sources, and the agent reaches for the right one on its own. Every action that touches the outside world asks first. Connect Home Assistant, Spotify or WordPress with your own account.

TALK TO IT - IRIS ORBIT
A full voice mode: talk to Iris Orbit or to your Buddy and it talks back, hands-free, with your tools and approvals working exactly as they do in chat.

MAKE THINGS, NOT JUST ANSWERS
Flow turns a brief into a finished document, deck or motion piece: 74 design aesthetics, your own brand kit, export as PDF, image or self-contained HTML. Lio builds a clickable app or prototype from a sentence - and shows you the plan before it starts. Studio generates images and video and designs social posts you can share to the community feed.

A COMPANION YOU CAN READ
Turn on the companion and a slim mood bar lives in your chat: warm when the work goes well, cool when it does not. Tap it and Conscious tells you what moved it today - no notifications, no sounds, it just shows.

A MEMORY THAT GROWS
Skales remembers what matters across conversations and adapts to you - stored on your device, fully under your control.

YOUR COMPUTER, FROM YOUR POCKET
Pair with the free Skales desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux over your WiFi, and your phone reaches your computer's AI, sessions, files and tools. Or open the in-app web interface from any browser on the same network.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE, NOT BY PROMISE
Your conversations and memory stay on your device by default. With your own key, requests go straight from your phone to the provider you chose - Skales runs no servers in between. No account required. No ads, no tracking, no data sold. Optional online features are clearly marked and off by default.
And when you want zero cloud: Skales Local (beta) downloads an openly licensed model once and answers directly on your iPhone or iPad - no key, no connection, even in airplane mode. Each model card says plainly what it can and cannot do.

DISCOVER
A live community feed, topic Spaces, and a personal news briefing pulled straight to your phone.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
Grandma approved AI agent. No technical knowledge needed. 12 languages.

Need help? 
Email request@skales.app - more at skales.app.

COMANDE SUA VIDA COM O HERO ASSISTANT
O Hero coloca toda a sua vida em um só lugar: calendários, tarefas, hábitos, notas, clima e muito mais — pra você nunca esquecer de nada.
Em vez de abrir 10 apps diferentes, agora você só precisa de 1 (perfeito pra quem tem TDAH!).

●

1. TUDO EM UM SÓ APP
-  Calendários – Sincronize Google, Outlook e iCloud em um só lugar, e nunca mais perca um compromisso.
-  Tarefas – Crie, organize, compartilhe e comente em listas de tarefas com amigos, parceiros ou família.
-  Hábitos – Acompanhe seus hábitos, veja suas sequências e sua evolução diária.
-  Notas – Faça anotações com texto ou áudio para planejar viagens, listas ou usar como diário com IA.
-  Clima – Veja a previsão do tempo integrada ao calendário, com detalhes de hora em hora e até 10 dias à frente.

●

2. NUNCA MAIS ESQUEÇA NADA, COM SUPERALERTAS
O Hero tem as notificações mais poderosas de qualquer app.
-  SuperAlertas – Complete ou adie tarefas e hábitos direto da tela bloqueada com alertas interativos.
-  Alertas Imperdíveis – Toques que funcionam mesmo com o celular no modo silencioso, pra garantir que você nunca esqueça algo importante — ideal pra quem é neurodivergente ou tem TDAH.

●

3. RECEBA LEMBRETES E AÇÕES PROATIVAS COM IA
Como seu assistente pessoal, o Hero te avisa do que vem pela frente e age por você.
-  Lembretes de eventos importantes – Nunca mais esqueça aniversários, formaturas e datas especiais.
-  Follow-ups – Reagende tarefas ou hábitos automaticamente, ou lembre alguém de concluir algo pendente.
-  Alertas de clima – Lembre-se de levar o guarda-chuva se for chover, ou se vestir melhor se o tempo mudar.
-  Ações sugeridas – Receba recomendações personalizadas com base na sua rotina.

●

4. COMECE SEU DIA COM O RESUMO DIÁRIO
O Hero te dá um panorama do dia logo pela manhã.
-  Agenda do dia – Veja seus compromissos, clima e tarefas de forma clara e rápida.
-  Mensagem motivacional – Comece o dia com uma frase inspiradora.

●

5. ORGANIZE JUNTO COM QUEM VOCÊ CONVIVE
-  Tarefas compartilhadas – Divida responsabilidades e comente nas tarefas.
-  Notas compartilhadas – Planeje viagens, eventos ou projetos com outras pessoas.
-  Comentários e imagens – Adicione contexto e mantenha tudo centralizado em um só lugar.

●

POR QUE USAR O HERO?
-  Nunca mais esqueça nada importante.
-  O app tudo-em-um que simplifica sua vida.

●

Dúvidas ou sugestões? Fale com a gente: brad@mail.tryhero.app
